$comment: One row per blockout layer the treatments may re-author. 'subject' is
shared across treatments; the full prompt is subject + keying suffix +
the treatment's promptStyle from treatments.json. mat.py reads 'frame'
from --blockout so the authored normalized geometry never drifts.
key: magenta = chroma-keyed cut-out; none = full-frame plate (cover-fit);
black = additive/emissive layer keyed against black.
Status legend: generated = PNG exists and was visually checked.
